description:
Increase your damage done to monsters with status effects by 1% for every 1 Ultimate you have, up to 133%. The cap is halved if Feral Guardian is active.

While you have 133 or more Ultimate, your Light and Heavy Attacks apply a random status effect, up to once every 2 seconds.

While equipped, applies Minor Timidity to you, consuming 1 Ultimate every 1.5 seconds in combat.
